column5: Look: modern smooth 2D, no pixels: clean vector shapes with soft gradients and glow, painterly dark backgrounds in layered parallax (deep teal and indigo, cool shadows), the player in warm amber and cream, threats in rust red and sick magenta, loot and light in gold. Bold dark outlines on figures, none on the background. Signature: the screen is dark and the player's lantern really lights it; a Flare floods the room with light for a moment. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.

References: Dead Cells (speed of movement and combat, side-view rooms, the run and permanent unlock loop: values only), Hades I and II (a boon chosen after each room, clear readable upgrade text, a death that still moves you forward: values only).
View: 2D side view · Camera: follows the player smoothly inside each room (`follow2d`), 1280x720 base, scales to fit.
Side-view movement: run, double jump, dash untouchable from its first moment
Melee strike combo with hit stop and knockback; health
The Lantern: charge from hits, Flare when full, light radius tied to charge
4 enemy kinds, each attacking differently (Rust Crawler charger, Wisp Bat swooper, Pike Sentry shielded spitter, Bloat exploder) and a Bell Warden boss
Rooms from hand-made layouts in a new order each run, safe first room, seed shown at the end
Boon choice after each room (one of three, each saying what it does), about 12 boons
Embers drop and fly to the player; Shrine between runs with permanent upgrades, saved
Ash levels: after a win, a harder run can be chosen
run system (runs that end in death) · in the slice
upgrades during a run (boons) · in the slice
permanent progression between runs · in the slice
rising difficulty on replay (Ash levels) · thin stand-in *(guessed)*
The title shows the knight with a dim lantern; Enter starts.
Room one is safe: a short corridor with on-screen key hints for move, jump and dash; the lantern barely lights the way.
Room two has two Rust Crawlers; striking them fills the lantern ring on the HUD, and at full the hint "L: Flare" pulses.
The Flare lights the whole room, stuns both, and the last one falls with a hard hit, a pause, and the door opens with a chime.
Three glowing boon cards appear: the player picks one, and the next room is already different.
Room two is gentle; by room four (about minute three) a mix of fliers and a shielded spitter forces dashing through shots.
Floor 2 adds the exploding Bloat and denser rooms; the run ends with a Bell Warden boss.
A death ends the run: boons are lost, collected Embers are kept and spent at the Shrine on small permanent upgrades (more health, a stronger Flare, a reroll).
After a win, the next run can be started at Ash level 1+ (enemies tougher and faster) for more Embers.
